description: Read the dinner plan for the week starting at weekStart (a Monday), one page of days at a time.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the page before — the date that page stopped at; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Days per page, 1-31; the whole week when omitted.

weekStart.description: Monday of the week, ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd).

name: get_week_plan
title: Week plan
